constraint.display: Unique name required for each instance
Write window end must not precede start
Name must be a valid C symbol

property.description: Not a calibrated command deadline. Expiry never authorizes Forced Stop. An incomplete extra command retains busy state; Reset retries read-mode recovery only after hardware completes.

Explicit opt-in for counter reads and temporary startup selection. Counter increment and permanent startup selection return FSP_ERR_UNSUPPORTED until authoritative maximum command timing is resolved and calibrated. NSC wrappers do not authorize these operations.
Stored for the flash interface only; blocking MRAM operations never invoke completion callbacks.

constraint.display: Callback must be a valid C symbol
